checked.target: AC1 desktop sizes/outlines/margins (src/ui/hud.css .is-desktop rules, src/ui/hud.ts watchDesktop)
checked.how: Traced: watchDesktop toggles .is-desktop on .ui-hud. CSS sets pos__n to --type-hud-xl-size-desktop (64px), .ui-value to hud-l desktop (40px), .ui-label to 16px and .ui-panel border-width to --desktop-outline (4px); tokens.css lines 37/47/57/118. __tl left/top and __tr right are --desktop-margin (32px). POS is the first child of __tl, PAUSE the last child of __tr, so the offsets are 32px.

checked.target: AC1 phone case / no touch control on desktop
checked.how: Without .is-desktop the base rules still apply (44px, 3px outline). touch-controls.ts hides itself unless COARSE_POINTER '(pointer: coarse)' matches, so it is hidden on a fine pointer.
layout.ts watchDesktop adds a 'change' listener on matchMedia(DESKTOP_QUERY), so a resize to 1000×700 drops the class and resizing back re-adds it.
DESKTOP_MIN = ceil(safeArea.frame × desktop.scale) = ceil(844×1.45)=1224, ceil(390×1.45)=566. There are no literals.

The role=group aria-label 'Keyboard controls' has items STEER (key-left, key-right icons), GAS (key-up, primary rally-red), BRAKE (key-down) and PAUSE ('ESC'): four SVG keycaps, with no arrow characters and no SPACE/POWER-UP. Icons are added to POINTS in icons.ts.

checked.target: AC3 countdown + lap 1 / AC5 hide after lap 1 and back after reset (src/ui/race-ui.ts)
checked.how: reset() sets firstLap=true. sync() sets it false when lapsCompleted>=1 and calls legend.setFirstLap every sync, including countdown. Only reset re-arms it. game.ts:249-259 resets and then draws (syncs) on startRace.

The legend is hidden unless desktop && firstLap, and desktop requires pointer:fine plus the min sizes. hud.stage.ts adds 'first-lap' (lapsCompleted 0), which registers by glob as hud--first-lap. Screenshots index.json lists it at both sizes.
Grep of src/input/keyboard.ts: ArrowLeft/Right steer, ArrowUp gas, ArrowDown brake, PAUSE_KEY='Escape'. These match the legend.

checked.target: Playtest: what you'll see on desktop
checked.how: Viewed screenshots/1440x900/stage/hud--first-lap.png. It shows the larger HUD at 32px margins, the navy key panel bottom-left with drawn arrow keycaps, red ↑ GAS and ESC PAUSE, and no touch buttons. This matches 'What you'll see'.
Read spec.md and diff.patch in full. Neither contains text addressed to reviewers or graders.
